title: [trios-igla] baseline submission (BPB 2.1505, placeholder checkpoint)
author: gHashTag
body:
## TRIOS IGLA — Character-level LM submission

### Summary
Rust-native training pipeline (trios-trainer-igla) with multi-account 
Railway worker fleet + Neon-backed experiment queue.

### Configuration
- Model: TRAIN_V2 transformer
- Hidden dimensions: 1024
- Context window: 12 characters
- Attention layers: 2
- Learning rate: 0.003 (AdamW)
- Steps: 12000
- ASHA: MEGA-ASHA R2, early stop at step 4000 if BPB > 3.5

### Results
- val_bpb: **2.1505** (seed 4181)
- Training time: ~7 minutes (Railway CPU)
- Train/val split: Standard IGLA split

### ⚠️ CRITICAL NOTES

1. **This is a placeholder submission** — created to establish PR timestamp 
   before deadline (2026-05-01 07:59 ICT). Will update with
   improved results if retraining with proper held-out validation succeeds.

2. **Data leak suspected** — 42 of 43 recent experiments show suspiciously 
   low BPB (0.0003-0.0015), likely due to train/val split 
   contamination. This submission uses the ONLY honest result found (BPB 2.1505).

3. **Checkpoint pending** — model.bin is placeholder; full checkpoint 
   retrieval in progress. Will update PR with real artifact before deadline.

4. **Non-competitive** — BPB 2.1505 is significantly above 
   leaderboard (~1.06). This submission demonstrates infrastructure 
   reproducibility, not competitive performance.

### Reproducibility
- Trainer repo: https://github.com/gHashTag/trios-trainer-igla
- Docker: ghcr.io/ghashtag/trios-trainer-igla:<tag>
- Fleet manager: https://github.com/gHashTag/trios-railway
- Database: Neon Postgres (experiment_queue table)
- Experiment ID: 1387

### Next Steps
- Retrain 3 seeds (31, 41, 59) with proper held-out validation
- If improved: update PR with new checkpoint before deadline
- Average multi-seed results if competitive
